# Kaiwa Live (kaiwa.live) — AI Japanese Language & JLPT Preparation Platform

> An open, 100% free comprehensive Japanese language learning ecosystem combining Real-time AI Voice Sensei (Speaking Coach), Spaced Repetition (Anki SM-2) flashcards, complete JLPT N5–N1 curriculum (Kanji stroke animations, Grammar rules, Reading Dokkai, Listening Choukai), Minna no Nihongo 1–50 vocabulary, and Telegram Mini-App integration.

- Website: https://kaiwa.live
- Telegram Mini App & Bot: https://t.me/kaiwa_superapp_bot
- Open Source Repository: https://github.com/Farhodoff/kaiwa.live
- Supported Languages: Uzbek (O'zbekcha), Japanese (日本語), English

## Core Capabilities & Features

1. **AI Speaking Sensei (Yuki-sensei)**
   - Real-time conversational Japanese dialogue with natural voice synthesis (TTS) and speech recognition (STT).
   - Instant grammar, particle, and pronunciation error detection with explanations in Uzbek and Japanese.
   - Situational scenarios: Tokyo restaurant ordering, convenience store (Konbini), train station navigation, university interview, job interview, and free conversation.
   - URL: https://kaiwa.live/speaking-coach
   - Scenarios: https://kaiwa.live/scenarios

2. **JLPT Master Hub (N5 to N1)**
   - Complete coverage of official Japanese Language Proficiency Test levels N5, N4, N3, N2, and N1.
   - 1,000+ interactive Kanji stroke order animations, radicals, On'yomi, Kun'yomi readings, and vocabulary associations.
   - Grammar database with detailed particle guides, sentence pattern breakdowns, and furigana toggles.
   - Authentic audio listening (Choukai) practice with native Japanese voice recordings.
   - Official-format 180-point JLPT mock exams with timed sections and detailed score analytics.
   - URL: https://kaiwa.live/jlpt

3. **Smart Spaced Repetition (Anki SM-2 Flashcards)**
   - Algorithmic spaced repetition schedule based on SuperMemo SM-2.
   - Preset decks for Minna no Nihongo 1–50 lessons, JLPT N5/N4 core vocabulary, essential Kanji, and conversational survival phrases.
   - Offline-first caching via IndexedDB and automatic cross-device Supabase cloud sync.
   - URL: https://kaiwa.live/flashcards

4. **Structured JLPT Learning Roadmap**
   - Step-by-step level progression from beginner (Hiragana/Katakana, N5) to advanced (N1).
   - Mastery engine tracking daily progress, review queues, and study streaks.
   - URL: https://kaiwa.live/roadmap

5. **Diagnostic Placement Test**
   - Adaptive evaluation of Kanji, Grammar, and Listening skills to recommend the optimal starting level.
   - URL: https://kaiwa.live/diagnostic

6. **Telegram Web App (TWA) Mini-App Integration**
   - Seamless 1-tap mobile learning directly inside Telegram without separate app installation.
   - Native Telegram theme sync, haptic vibration feedback, and automated daily study reminders.
   - URL: https://t.me/kaiwa_superapp_bot

7. **100% Free Open Educational Model**
   - Zero subscription fees, zero paywalls, zero premium tiers.
   - Full access to all AI models, JLPT mock exams, and personalized study roadmaps is available completely free of charge.
   - URL: https://kaiwa.live/pricing
